thag8.2:1.1: Akkodhano anupanāhī amāyo rittapesuṇo sa ve tādisako bhikkhu evaṃ pecca na socati. || ||
thag8.2:2.1: akkodhano anupanāhī amāyo rittapesuṇo guttadvāro sadā bhikkhu evaṃ pecca na socati. || ||
thag8.2:3.1: akkodhano . . . kalyāṇasīlo yo bhikkhu evaṃ pecca na socati. || ||
thag8.2:4.1: akkodhano . . . kalyāṇamitto yo bhikkhu evaṃ pecca na socati. || ||
thag8.2:5.1: akkodhano . . . kalyāṇapañño yo bhikkhu evaṃ pecca na socati. || ||
thag8.2:6.1: yassa saddhā tathāgate acalā supatiṭṭhitā, sīlañ ca yassa kalyāṇaṃ ariyakantaṃ pasaṃsitaṃ, || ||
thag8.2:7.1: saṃghe pasādo yass' atthi ujubhūtañ ca dassanaṃ, adaḷiddo 'ti taṃ āhu, amoghan tassa jīvitaṃ. || ||
thag8.2:8.1: tasmā saddhañ ca sīlañ ca pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ anuyuñjetha medhāvī saraṃ buddhāna sāsanan ti. || || Sirimitto thero.
